Start using KeiHome
Make your home screen your own
A few steps to explore KeiHome and check what is ready. You can skip optional setup and return here from Settings.
Icons that fit together
After activation, system icons can follow light/dark mode automatically. Extra packs and Monet colors are optional.
A more personal launcher
Explore Dock glass, launcher glass styles and long app names.
Changes you control
Browsing keeps current settings. You choose whether to change packs or enable Monet and desktop effects.
Check the module environment
KeiHome uses LSPosed API 102. Enable the module in your manager and grant the scopes needed by the features you use. You can continue even if setup is incomplete.
Framework service connected
Framework service not connected yet

After first enabling the module and confirming its scope, restart the system once as recommended. Later updates and supported settings use API 102 automatic hot reload. A connected service and granted scope do not mean hooks are loaded; check Status for the actual launcher connection.
Choose an icon style
Keep system icons for automatic light/dark behavior. Extra packs and Monet are optional; return here after exploring.
System icons follow light/dark mode after activation
Optional: preview built-in styles, APK packs or MTZ / ZIP files before applying.
Optional: enable dynamic colors for supported icons, independently of light/dark mode.
Optional: review how uncovered icons are filled, and adjust after changing packs.
Preview, apply, then check

After changing packs, completion rules, or generation scope, use the page’s floating action button to generate and apply the update, then check the launcher. Supported light/dark and palette changes sync automatically.\n\nSettings → Icon packs and actions controls automatic application and generation scope. By default, mappings for uninstalled apps are kept. Installed-app-only generation reduces the generated pack’s size; newly installed apps may then need an update.
Make optional adjustments

Explore the same controls as the Desktop tab. Supported changes sync automatically without repeated launcher restarts; check Status for the launcher connection and settings acknowledgement. Availability depends on the launcher. Opening this page keeps your settings unchanged.
Open desktop settings
Dock glass, corner styles, glass rendering and app names.
Ready to explore
You have reached the end of the guide. Optional setup can be completed later, and this guide is always available in Settings.
The Status page shows module and launcher health. Finishing this guide does not imply that every scope or feature is active.
Module feature issues need LSPosed logs

Icons, Dock, other hooks that do not work, and launcher jank need logs exported from LSPosed. App logs only cover KeiHome’s own interface, settings, and similar issues; they cannot replace LSPosed logs. Include the environment details from About when reporting an issue.
Open LSPosed for feature issues; use the floating export button for App issues
Review usage; the floating button clears only in-memory icon previews and preserves the applied theme
